study_type: Cross-provider consumer-UI evaluation under standardized user-level prompt protocol
limitations: Consumer interfaces do not guarantee pinned backend model snapshots.
One first response per prompt and interface; no repeated-run variance estimate.
No web search, retrieval, file upload or external tools were used.
Reference contexts were evaluator-only and not supplied to the models.
Primary annotation set is assistant-drafted and requires project-owner expert sign-off before being described as human-verified.
